sup:70740.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to present our competitive quote for your requirements. Our price is €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining your position.

Our data shows a different picture on some points:
Alloy surcharge 1.4404, Isartal Edelstahlwerk (fictional mill, derived) changed -5.5% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09).

Please find our proposal below.

We look forward to your reply.

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains. We have reviewed your data regarding the alloy surcharge and the updated volume forecast, which allows us to adjust our position. We are pleased to accommodate your request for a 36-month contract and 60-day payment terms. However, a fixed price over three years is not feasible, so we have included an index clause for AS-14404 and offer a revised price of €5.50 per unit. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. 

Our proposal comprises a price of €5.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Our offer stays valid 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

decisions.tactician: E0 is the only selectable option, because every alternative term mix has unknown supplier trade value. It also gives a far lower C than the open quote. Of the three arguments, a1 and a4 directly rebut the supplier's index story. a3 answers its stated focus on volume customers, and the longer commitment fits that need. a2 is held back to keep the tone constructive this round. It is an early counter, so anchoring low is appropriate.

decisions.tactician: o4 has a slightly lower C than E0, but it drops the clause the supplier explicitly insists on, and its estimate excludes unmeasured supplier values, so it would likely trigger a counter or harden its position. E0 grants the clause it asked for, keeps 36 months and 60 d, and at the current concession pace it may land in about one reply. The delivery-record argument is a new argument kind for this supplier and supports a lower price. Accepting €5.50 now would leave substantial value on the table.

That is effectively accepting its number while removing a term it explicitly requested, and its acceptance is uncertain. Its saving is only an estimate of about €1,068, which sits within the model's error. E0 keeps the clause it wants and continues its steady concession pace; one more reply should land near €5.16, giving C of €252,288 versus €259,133 for accepting now. No arguments remain unheard, so we send none.
